purpose: The always-on-mic indicator: a ring just inside the bezel whose state is the whole message. Idle is near invisible, listening breathes, thinking rotates a conic gap, speaking holds steady.

states.recipe: The ring at 8 percent opacity; present but not read.
A 2.4s ease-in-out breathe on the ring.
A conic gradient with a 60 degree gap rotating over 3s, masked to the ring width.
The ring at full opacity, still.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not mount it while the app is inactive
antiPatterns.why: the parent gates rendering on isActive; an unmounted ring is the cheapest ring on a Pi that runs for weeks

antiPatterns.rule: Do not show it on a device without a microphone
antiPatterns.why: only Fast carries the Fusion HAT mic; a ring on Small or Square promises listening that cannot happen
